clusters.headline: DNA Testing Used To Identify Victims Of PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Fire
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities are collecting DNA samples and ante mortem data from families to identify victims recovered from the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia fire.
Search and rescue teams have recovered 24 body bags, while 32 employees remain reported as missing following the blaze.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto To Submit Two VP Candidates To MPR On Nov 23
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is expected to deliver two vice presidential candidate names to the MPR.
The submission follows a vacancy in the vice president position after the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: KPK To Imprison Three Former Customs Officials In Graft Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) is preparing to execute prison sentences for three former officials.
The officials, identified as Rizal, Sisprian, and Orlando, received sentences of nine, seven, and six years respectively.

clusters.headline: Twenty Four Confirmed Dead In PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Factory Fire
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesian authorities have recovered 24 bodies from the site of a confectionery factory fire in Cikande.
Rescuers are continuing to search for approximately 30 workers who remain missing following the weekend incident.

clusters.headline: COP31 Climate Conference In Turkey Ends Without Final Agreement
aiSummaryBullets: The UN climate summit COP31 held in Turkey concluded without reaching a final agreement.
Proposed climate funding deals valued at trillions were left unfinalized.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Government Announces CPNS 2026 Recruitment Schedule
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian government has scheduled the start of CPNS 2026 registration for November 27.
Minister of PAN-RB Rini Widayanti stated that the recruitment seeks to fill 167,113 civil servant positions.

clusters.headline: BMKG Issues Severe Weather Alerts For Major Indonesian Cities
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG issued warnings for light to heavy rain accompanied by lightning and strong winds across many Indonesian cities.
Residents in regions like Jakarta and Bogor are reporting localized weather shifts, including midday heat followed by evening precipitation.

clusters.headline: Indonesia And European Union Sign The IEU-CEPA Trade Agreement
aiSummaryBullets: The IEU-CEPA agreement removes tariffs on more than 90 percent of traded goods between Indonesia and the European Union.
President Prabowo Subianto oversaw the signing, with officials expecting the deal to become fully implemented by early 2027.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Selatan Deploys 50 Personnel To Handle Pejaten Timur Landslide
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta Selatan municipal administration deployed 50 joint personnel to manage the site following repeated landslides in Pejaten Timur.
Recent heavy rainfall triggered secondary landslides that disconnected Jalan Langgar II and caused the Poltangan waterway to overflow into residential areas.

clusters.headline: Iran Drone Strike Hits Bahrain Civilian Site And Targets Tankers
aiSummaryBullets: Bahrain reported that a Bahraini and a Pakistani citizen were injured following an attack attributed to Iran.
Official reports state the strike hit a civilian industrial facility, while additional incidents involve missiles launched at two tankers.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Discusses BTS Jakarta Concert With South Korean President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto met with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung at the ASEAN Summit to discuss the upcoming BTS concert in Jakarta.
The third day of the BTS performance in Indonesia will be broadcast live across 2,800 cinema screens in more than 80 countries.

clusters.headline: Kapolda Metro Jaya Dadang Hartanto Rombak Jajaran Pejabat Tinggi
aiSummaryBullets: Kapolda Metro Jaya Dadang Hartanto merotasi sejumlah posisi strategis termasuk Kapolres, Kasat Reskrim, dan Kapolsek.
Mutasi pejabat di lingkungan Polda Metro Jaya ini dilakukan menyusul kebijakan rotasi yang ditetapkan oleh Kapolri.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Expands Indonesia's Global Partnerships
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia signed major agreements with the European Union covering trade, investment, and sustainable economic growth.
Bilateral partnerships were announced regarding nuclear energy development, clean energy technology, and waste management cooperation.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto Mutasi 704 Personel Kepolisian
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto has reassigned 704 police officers in a widespread internal rotation.
The reshuffle involves changes to high-ranking positions, including the appointment of six new regional police chiefs and seven deputy chiefs.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Pass Asset Recovery Bill Into National Law
aiSummaryBullets: The Asset Recovery Law has been formally enacted by the Indonesian government.
Prosecutors are preparing for in absentia trials to pursue assets linked to major corruption fugitives.

clusters.headline: Regional Governments In Indonesia Intensify Disaster Preparedness
aiSummaryBullets: Provincial and city governments are implementing infrastructure upgrades, including new pump houses and river normalization to mitigate flood risks.
Regional authorities are focusing on cross-sector coordination and increased emergency personnel to improve response times during the rainy season.

clusters.headline: Antam Gold Price Increases To Rp2,505,000 Per Gram In Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices rose by Rp10,000 to reach Rp2,505,000 per gram on Monday, November 23, 2026.
The official buyback price for Antam gold also saw an increase, climbing to Rp2,115,000 per gram.

clusters.headline: Bogor Syndicate Sends 200 Indonesians to Fight as Russian Mercenaries
aiSummaryBullets: A trafficking syndicate based in Bogor has allegedly facilitated the departure of 200 Indonesian nationals to join the Russian military.
Recruits are reportedly lured with high salaries, often utilizing routes through Thailand to reach their destination.

clusters.headline: MPR Reviews Mahfud MD Concerns Over Vice President Election Date
aiSummaryBullets: Mahfud MD stated the vice president election scheduled for December 9, 2026, could be invalid due to procedural timeline issues.
The MPR Ad Hoc Committee is currently evaluating these concerns regarding the 14-day working deadline for candidate submission.

clusters.headline: PSSI Prepares New Coach for Timnas Indonesia U-23 Replacing Herdman
aiSummaryBullets: PSSI is actively seeking a new head coach for the Timnas Indonesia U-23 national team.
The leadership change follows previous reports of John Herdman evaluating young talent for the SEA Games 2027 roster.
